column1: # NFTBan — DECLARED SLSA PROVENANCE SUBJECT POPULATION  (v1.229.4 VAF-0 Stage 1)
# ⛔ THIS FILE IS HAND-MAINTAINED AND MUST NEVER BE GENERATED FROM WHAT IS FOUND ON DISK.
#     PROVENANCE_FILES_FOUND  must NOT define  PROVENANCE_FILES_EXPECTED
# If the expected population were enumerated from the files present, then a MISSING
# provenance file would simply disappear from the enumeration, the expected population
# would shrink to match reality, and the false green would survive the fix. The whole
# point of this file is that reality is compared against a declaration reality cannot edit.
# WHY IT EXISTS — three witnesses against ONE validator (SLSA_VALIDATION_FALSE_GREEN):
#     L1  ZERO_SUBJECT_ITERATION          `for binary in dist/nftban-*` matching nothing
#                                         left VERIFY_FAILED=0 -> "verified"
#     L2  REQUIRED_SUBJECT_ABSENCE_SKIPPED `if [ -f "$provenance" ]` with NO else -> a
#                                         SHIPPED BINARY WITH NO PROVENANCE passed the
#                                         provenance check
#     L3  EXPECTED_POPULATION_NOT_ASSERTED no declared population existed at all
# ADDING a subject is a deliberate act: add the row, and the verifier will require it.
# REMOVING a subject is equally deliberate and must be justified in review — it is the
# only way to stop requiring provenance for something we ship.
# ⛔ NOT every shipped binary is an SLSA subject today. `nftband-linux-amd64` is published
#    WITHOUT provenance (it carries a SHA256SUMS entry instead, while nftban-core carries
#    provenance but NO SHA256SUMS entry — see the F1 capsule finding). That asymmetry is a
#    SUPPLY-CHAIN COVERAGE QUESTION and is deliberately NOT decided here. This file records
#    what IS covered, so the validator stops lying about it; it does not assert that the
#    coverage is sufficient.

column2: dist/ is populated by exactly two download-artifact steps: the nftban-core binary and its provenance. That is the entire SLSA subject population as shipped in v1.229.3, verified against the published release asset list. v1.229.4 R2 moved those steps from slsa-go-releaser.yml (deleted) into release.yml/verify-release; the SUBJECT POPULATION IS UNCHANGED — only the workflow that downloads it moved.
